title: Vesper and the Postcard Anew
author: Dominic Coldharbour
blurb: Wendell Nystrom, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
